## wax.diff.regex-syntax
# Regex syntax in the pattern (2 rows)
# picomatch and micromatch read `(…)` as a group and `|` as alternation, as a
# regex would. globstar has no such syntax: the characters are literal
# (GLOB_SPEC §2).
# wax: match  [src/lib.rs:1834]

## wax.diff.we-reject-UnterminatedClass
# A `[` that never closes (1 row)
# globstar reads classes by POSIX's rules (GLOB_SPEC §8.5): a `]` first in the
# list is literal, and a class cannot hold `/`, so a `[` with no closing `]`
# after that is a parse error. The library accepts the pattern, as literal
# text or with the class crossing `/`; its answer is the row's comment.
# wax: no-match  [src/lib.rs:1686]
a[/]b	a/b	err:UnterminatedClass

## wax.diff.negated-class-slash
# A negated class and a `/` (1 row)
# A class never matches `/` (GLOB_SPEC §8.2), negated or not. The library lets
# `[!a]` consume a separator.
# wax: match  [src/lib.rs:1776]
<[!.]*/>[!.]*	a/b/file.ext	no-match
